description: Turn an intent into a fillable, dispatchable quote request. Supply the buyer's context and get back a filled request plus ready-to-send text. Pure computation: this site never transmits the request and never asserts prices or vendors.

context.description: Buyer-supplied values for required_fields / optional_fields. Unknown keys are ignored.

id.description: Intent id, e.g. book-flight or buy-vps

name: build_request
